profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Specialties: Oracle PL/SQL, SQL, XML

Having been in the IT arena since 1981, about a quarter of those years as a consultant, and working with Oracle  since 1997, I can call on past experiences and put all my various industries and technologies learned to work on Analysis and Design of complex software systems and process automation, including hands on "full stack" development
